title: HB_MEASUREMENTS — Haemoglobin Measurements
description: The date and haemoglobin value measured at donation by the Haemospect, Hemocue and Orsense devices.
$comment: Units are as written in the source: g/l for Haemospect and Hemocue, g/dL for Orsense. The dictionary states no ranges, so none are asserted; values are typed number because no data type is stated (D035). The time-of-measurement columns are not requested.
